news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba stock rose 12% in the past week after Apple picked Qwen for its China AI launch. Money also rotated out of US AI hardware into cheap Chinese internet stocks like Alibaba and Tencent.

news.title: Nvidia’s Chinese Clients Will Get Just 1% of $70 Billion in RTX Chip Orders
news.summary: Key TakeawaysChinese AI and cloud firms, Alibaba among them, have ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips worth about $70 billion, but expect to get only about 1% of them over the next four months. With too little capacity to go around, NVIDIA is building its most advanced, higher-margin chips first, so China’s orders are left waiting.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要中國 AI 與雲端企業（包括阿里巴巴）已訂購約 6 million 顆 NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 晶片，價值約 $70 billion，但預期未來四個月僅能獲得其中約 1%。因產能不足，NVIDIA 優先生產最先進、利潤較高的晶片，導致中國訂單被迫等待。

news.title: Kroger and Albertsons’ CEOs Just Signaled the Walmart Price Gap Is Here to Stay. It Costs a Couple About $1,000 a Year.
news.summary: Kroger's CEO told investors in September that "we're not in the game of being the cheapest," and Albertsons' CEO named Walmart, Amazon and Aldi as where her shoppers go. Consumer Reports measured the gap at 14.8% for Kroger, 20.3% for Publix and 24.8% for Albertsons against Walmart. Here is what it costs a retired couple spending $7,800 a year, what their grocery bill looks like in 2027 on the USDA's new forecast, and the three moves that close most of the gap.
news.title_zh: Kroger 和 Albertsons 的執行長剛發出訊號，沃爾瑪的價格差距將長期存在。這讓一對夫婦每年損失約 $1,000。
news.summary_zh: Kroger 執行長在九月告訴投資者：「我們不玩最便宜的遊戲」，而 Albertsons 執行長點名沃爾瑪、亞馬遜和 Aldi 是其購物客去的地方。消費者報告測量的差距為：Kroger 為 14.8%，Publix 為 20.3%，Albertsons 為 24.8%（相對於沃爾瑪）。這裡說明一對每年花費 $7,800 的退休夫婦的成本，根據 USDA 的新預測，他們的雜貨帳單在 2027 的樣子，以及縮小大部分差距的三個舉措。

news.title: How Much More AI Stock Can the Market Absorb?
news.summary: Volatile trading in AI-related stocks this past week has put a spotlight on investors’ appetite for additional share offerings—and the prices companies could get if they opt to sell. While tech giants, chip companies and AI cloud providers have sold or priced more than $300 billion of new stock and mandatory convertible securities so far this year, another roughly $100 billion in potential share sales remains on tap. Most would come through at-the-market programs, which give companies the option to sell shares gradually into the open market, including a proposed $60 billion ATM from Meta Platforms that could launch in early 2027.
news.title_zh: 市場還能吸收多少 AI 股票？
news.summary_zh: 過去一週 AI 相關股票的波動交易，讓投資人對額外股票發行的胃納、以及企業若選擇出售所能獲得的價格成為焦點。雖然科技巨頭、晶片公司和 AI 雲端供應商今年以來已售出或定價超過 $300 billion 的新股票和強制可轉換證券，但另有約 $100 billion 的潛在股票銷售仍在計畫中。大多數將透過盤後定價發行計畫（ATM）進行，這類計畫讓企業可選擇逐步在公開市場出售股票，包括 Meta Platforms 擬議的 $60 billion ATM，可能於 2027 初推出。
